mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals robust consumer spending that directly boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM in more than 60% of periods but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in over 55% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it triggers immediate market concerns about persistent inflation, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% occurs in 60%+ of periods but 5-day forward returns are positive in over 55% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint labor market dynamics.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase occurs in 60%+ of periods but 60-day forward returns are negative in over 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain recovery (INDPRO growth > 0.5% month-over-month), expanded production capacity improves corporate margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO MoM growth > 0.5% occurs in 60%+ of periods but 20-day forward returns are negative in over 55% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,350,000 units (1350.0 in thousands), it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1350.0 occurs in 60%+ of periods but 5-day forward returns are negative in over 55% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline occurs in 60%+ of periods but 20-day forward returns are negative in over 55% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based demand expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through cross-sector economic momentum.
failure_condition: Joint RSAFS and HOUST increase occurs in 60%+ of periods but 60-day forward returns are negative in over 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% occurs in 60%+ of periods and UNRATE declines month-over-month, but 20-day forward returns are negative in over 55% of those cases.
